'''Margess Base''' was a structure located west of [[Autumna Planitia]]. While extracting information from a drunk [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Corellian whiskey)|bounty hunter]] about the location of an individual referred to as "furball," [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] learned that he was at Margess Base. Skywalker then asked the [[Unidentified bartender (Corellian whiskey)|bartender]] how to reach Margess Base, and was directed to travel west over [[Autumna Planitia]].<ref name="RPG" />
